connector.name: Zotero MCP
connector.registryDescription: Search, read, annotate, and add to your Zotero research library, local or web.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package zotero-mcp-server. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the 54yyyu account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: ZOTERO_LOCAL
env.description: Read from the local Zotero desktop app instead of the web API. Requires Zotero 7+ with the local API enabled in Settings > Advanced.

env.name: ZOTERO_API_KEY
env.description: Zotero Web API key from https://www.zotero.org/settings/keys. Only needed when ZOTERO_LOCAL is false, or for write operations in hybrid mode.

env.name: ZOTERO_LIBRARY_ID
env.description: Zotero user or group library ID. Only needed when ZOTERO_LOCAL is false, or for write operations in hybrid mode.

env.name: ZOTERO_LIBRARY_TYPE
env.description: Whether ZOTERO_LIBRARY_ID refers to a personal or a group library.
